gate: passed before specification or repository research
method: Full original text displayed and processed across root and three readers. Exact duplicates verified by hash and byte equality. Truncated initial attempts replaced by complete bounded reads. CRLF normalization accounted for.
limits: This ledger covers the supplied project set. Current repository reads were targeted separately, and unavailable installed game files were not read.
